newsitem.title: UK: Moody's rates Tepco's bonds due 2007 AAA.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates Tepco's bonds due 2007 AAA.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service has assigned a Aaa rating to The Tokyo Electric Power Co., Inc.'s (TEPCO) Yen100 billion, 2.625% domestic bonds, due 2007, the rating agency said on Tuesday.
"The rating is based on TEPCO's importance to the national economy and the very favorable industry operating environment," Moody's said in a statement.
Moody's said TEPCO had an effective monopoly to serve Japan's most important economical region, the Kanto region which includes the Tokyo metropolitan area.
The service territory of TEPCO has over 30% of Japan's population and over 35% of the national GDP, it said.

"TEPCO thus plays a significant role in the national economic and energy policy, which makes it highly likely that the company would receive strong regulatory and governmental support if and when needed," it said.
